title: Strengthen acceptance-policy argument validation regression coverage
outcome: Claude7199 test Note: idempotency_key newline is rejected at required prefix before charset check. Add a valid-prefix invalid-character case and explicit actor single-argv-token builder assertion. Parent correction: normalize_engram_host_settings already bounds developerName to64 and ASCII letters/digits/dot/underscore/hyphen; production actor is not unvalidated, and Command uses argv not shell. Test hardening only, no confirmed injection defect.
acceptance:
C1 (idempotency-key charset and length are each exercised on their own).
- A test in src/tests/acceptance_settings.rs asserts that `args` returns Err for keys that PASS the `termal-policy-` prefix check and fail only the charset check: `termal-policy-a\nb`, `termal-policy-a b`, `termal-policy-a;b`, `termal-policy-a_b` and `termal-policy-ä`.
- It also asserts Err for a prefixed, valid-charset key of 101 characters, and Ok for one of exactly 100 characters.

C2 (the actor stays a single argv token).
- A test asserts that, for actors containing a space, `=`, a quote, `;`, `$(…)`, a leading `--`, or a newline, `args` returns exactly one element holding the actor text: `--authorized-by=<actor>`, byte for byte.
- It also asserts that the argv length and every other element equal those produced with a plain actor.

C3 (test-only).
- The change touches only src/tests/acceptance_settings.rs, with no production code and no policy or authority change.
- Every existing acceptance_settings test passes unchanged.

C4 (validation and landing).
- The full gate passes on the exact tree submitted for landing.
- The review pair has no outstanding finding of Medium or higher on it.
- The item carries the evidence the standing landing rule requires.
